title: Re: Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 7B: Droopy Earlobes, Cauliflower Ears, and Monobrows and Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 7B: Droopy Earlobes, Cauliflower Ears, and Monobrows and Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

I am a bit mystified as to exactly how Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna got back into Storeroom 7B, but she did, and now I need you to go back in there and deal with her. I hear if you act like a brat and make the dungeon really dirty she will get really annoyed with you. I don't know how that will help you, but it sounds like it would make for an entertaining musical!

Get back into Storeroom 7B and take care of Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna and her wierd little Abba Labba minions. When you have finished, return to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, here in The Embercore Portal.

Turn-in:

You are really quite useful, Dungeon Runner! Let me know if you want to try this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna
  • Kill Abba Labbas

Client level range: 45–46
